theme: The origin story of the Meme Arcana – Wojak’s journey from normie to legend
global_event: A crack forms in the digital sky, and raw meme energy rains down, transforming the Banlands forever.
narrative_steps: Average Wojak stares at a cracked phone screen, trapped in an endless scroll of normie content.
Doomer Wojak appears, whispering that the grind is pointless and the void is inevitable.
The protagonist tries to escape his feelings, morphing into a Soyjak – exaggerated tears and flailing.
Wifejak gently places a hand on his shoulder, offering a warm cup of tea and a knowing smile.
Smug Wojak challenges an NPC in a debate, winning with a single raised eyebrow and a folded paper fan.
Clown Pepe (Honkler) appears, honking a horn and scattering chaotic energy, confusing both hero and enemy.
The hero is tempted by the Stonks Meme, who presents a rising chart and whispers of easy wealth.
Monkey Puppet slowly turns its head, giving the side‑eye that exposes the hero’s self‑deception.
GigaChad emerges from the rift – jaw sharp, aura glowing – representing the final ascension from normie to legend.

recurring_mascot.description: A tiny pixelated bird with one glowing blue eye and one red, leaving faint digital afterimages
